name: kickoff_outcome_dead_even_tie_is_scored_by_who_touches_last_FINDING
description: FINDING (current behaviour): a symmetric 50/50. Blue at (0,-1300) and orange at (0,1300) boost at the ball and both touch it on the same step (frame 17), so firstTouch is 0 for both. The ball is then fought over and ends in the air at the centre (frame 48: y = -106, vy = -706). The only large term left is possession, which is the team of `gs.lastTouchCarID`: on this run the last touch step (frame 48) was blue alone, so blue +0.2 and orange -0.2, giving blue +0.137 / orange -0.137 (+1.6 / -1.6 weighted). With the other order the same race would score the other way: a pure tie is scored by who happens to touch last, and when both touch on the same step the engine's id is the higher player index (orange). Verified independently: the formula re-evaluated by a separate script on the ball state and touches read from the exported run reproduces the reward to 5 digits.

expect.intent: a dead-even race scores +0.137 for blue on this run (possession decided by last touch)
